# AI in Finance Daily — 2026-11-22

*The AI trade cracks, and now the regulators and the balance sheets are showing up.*

## 🔎 The lead
**Nvidia is under SEC investigation, and the whole AI trade is unwinding around it.** The agency is probing Nvidia's accounting practices, per the NYT [74](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5qSmxMVy1SN0NxMVRKNy1XTmdKbUJ0WVI4VlUwM3RQWnJvNkE0M1pLVVk3bHJZUUtYWUFJdUJjMllKbXhyYzNOR1dDazVJN2ZmaGxENktCS213Q29Vc2paREMxOEZGZkw5QzNHcU5KRjJxdVBjdHM2SlpR?oc=5), sending the stock down roughly 14% [88](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNWmNHUy1JZVMwYTJuX05OcmxQMUZkcnlIUWlEcnM2ZUpwYWFuMzV2SVNOcURMNlBQSWVNWVg2dGQzOXh4aDRLQnpTekM1QlJ3cXBaZnhkTkVmcGZGN3JVaE12SUtCa2h2M0dsNjBJN1BGS3hmOEQxTlBRWmV5MlB6bnB0REJ3TjM4UGQ5Z1FPMVMyMWhzM2MxRFEtTXdfcnVDXzEzZ2xUc2RLYTRF). The S&P 500 has slid into a correction, and Goldman Sachs says the "AI unwind" has spiraled into something more dangerous, naming three signs it's watching for a bottom [81](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOWElreEFzaFE1QnFoaU1hSW50bzh5aXAtZnRSclhUMGY0WFFKOGo3YUJPZ05BR3lGeVpIMXZyQ3RVOURMLU8xNEw1aVo0NnFkZjRIbVRRWXd4UVpkU05PV2lTM1FNUnBwa3NYS3FyOWgzV2JVc0VEZEtkUUtianY3bDMwcGtkN2NoXzA2Y2JfUVRTYXNSLVo4UGw0ZEdMSEY1YWx0VWxHWG93V1J2V3FHTmdLRW1BenBob0NsZk1n), [73](https://news.google.). The probe hands bears a fundamental—not just valuation—reason to sell the most important stock in the market. **So what:** When the index's single largest weight faces an accounting inquiry mid-selloff, "buy the dip" gets a lot harder to argue.

## ⚡ The big picture
**Anthropic's debut flops.** The $81.3B-raising IPO slid as Morgan Stanley ended price-stabilization support, leaving Wall Street asking what can rescue the AI trade [78](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxQNXpwSFlvQVZzOWoybWpmUUdRTmhnR09fdkVqNXdLTVo5a3dlMWU3aG9iZ24xaVh0RFd0YWEtSVF6Y1BGcmpFRnJUV21oVVhnWENyS3FHbjhWVzMwOHF6UjFsNk5ONjNUUENaNzBfb0cxX2hHNVJJZ3M4eGktRVUzazUtZ014bHczN05nVnlDWmpQNGE4dl8yUnVJMjNqc3FVN25teFNJT041Y3FqbnNONEs3bkVLTXJNUmw1b0FTQ3c4UkdxVnlLR0RFa2tZZw), [69](https://news.google.).

**AI's debt engine keeps humming.** SpaceX raised ~$44B in GPU debt financing led by Apollo and Goldman, including $32B in bonds to buy Nvidia chips [96](https://news.google.). **So what:** The equity selloff and the private-credit spigot are, for now, running in opposite directions.

**A former SEC chair sees bankruptcies coming** as the cycle turns [85](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE1uTFdsaFBnbDFGRjFnUVdieHJRb29LNzlPV3FCc3JUbjU5YWVxeTloV3FpMEhqdExmUTZPS2dGZWhmYVQtakdHYWZFVG1xZTZtdzZPWGhnQmQ1NzdwbDR1eWVZXy1Fa01zZkRN) *(thin sourcing)*.

## 🗒️ Fine print
- Nvidia probe sourced to NYT via "media"; strongest confirmation is the NYT item itself [74](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5qSmxMVy1SN0NxMVRKNy1XTmdKbUJ0WVI4VlUwM3RQWnJvNkE0M1pLVVk3bHJZUUtYWUFJdUJjMllKbXhyYzNOR1dDazVJN2ZmaGxENktCS213Q29Vc2paREMxOEZGZkw5QzNHcU5KRjJxdVBjdHM2SlpR?oc=5).
- "Former SEC chair warns bankruptcies coming" [85] is Arabic-language and headline-thin—directional, not verified.
- Anthropic's "$81.3B raised" figure comes from one aggregator [52]; treat the precise number cautiously.
- SpaceX financing figures vary across items ($32B bonds, $44B total)—both cited, same deal [93](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPU3QyXzk0cGZCY1pUTUlHSHZzZmw3RS1xdzNNeF9JZFJlWTdtcG9fRzlpNFpiazU4R3VSZmxhSTlqeDVZOUJzZUV3b1hJT191ZFlUMFlQUV9lWlhueHczQ2taWHZlSFIwUmtUQmpNUlBtUU1HS0FSVHYzYWxoWGhzLUNzMHR1dUNIeThwMA), [96](https://news.google.).
